summary: Frontend E2E test of the new Live Position page (/pair/BTCUSDT). 11/12 requested flows pass. One CRITICAL layout bug found: Edit Position modal Save button is fully overlapped by the fixed bottom navigation on the mobile viewport (420x900), making it unclickable for a real user. All other flows work: header, coin card, live price + 24h change, 11 stat cards, dynamic ladder count matching margin_call_limit (verified 9→10), C1..CN call cards, current price row, refresh toast, 3-dot menu with all 6 items, Edit Strategy nav, Coin-card nav to /trade-settings, Start Bot / Stop Bot state transitions, ts-limit change dynamically updates ladder call cards, and dark mode renders correctly (no white cards).

ui_bugs.issue: The Save Position button (lp-posedit-save) is completely covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile viewport (420x900). Measured: save button rect y=820.5, h=46.5, viewport h=900; bottom-nav is fixed at bottom with h-20 (80px), starting at y=820. `document.elementFromPoint(saveCenterX, saveCenterY)` returns the <nav data-testid="bottom-nav"> element, not the save button. A real user tapping Save hits the bottom-nav's Trade tab. Playwright force-click also fails to trigger onClick — modal just closes via backdrop propagation. The POST /api/bots/{sym}/position endpoint itself works fine (verified via JS .click() and via curl). The Import balance button and inputs above are also close to the overlap zone. FIX: hide bottom-nav while modal is open, OR render modal in a portal with z-index above bottom-nav (bottom-nav appears to have equal/higher z compared to the fixed inset modal), OR change items-end to items-center on mobile too, OR add bottom padding pb-24 to modal container so Save clears the 80px nav.

Slug generation `label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')` leaves a TRAILING hyphen when the label ends with `)` — e.g. 'Position amount (USDT)' → data-testid=`lp-stat-position-amount-usdt-` (trailing dash) instead of the spec's `lp-stat-position-amount-usdt`. Same for `lp-stat-position-quantity-btc-`. FIX: append `.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')` after the replace to trim leading/trailing dashes.

Once main agent adds pb-24 (or portals modal above bottom-nav / hides bottom-nav on modal open), re-test by clicking lp-posedit-save via a NORMAL click (not force / not JS.click) and verify: (a) POST /api/bots/BTCUSDT/position fires, (b) 'Position updated' toast, (c) lp-stat-numbers-of-call-margin card shows new value, (d) lp-ladder-count updates 'X Left', (e) lp-call-used-1..N cards render. Also verify the testid slug fix for lp-stat-position-amount-usdt (no trailing hyphen). Dark mode and dynamic ladder count already confirmed working.
rca of the issue: Root cause: modal outer container uses `flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4` — on <sm mobile (420px), modal panel is aligned to bottom edge (items-end) with only p-4 (16px) padding. The Save button lies within the last ~46px of the modal; combined with the modal itself extending to viewport bottom minus 16px, the button's y-range (820..866) fully falls inside the fixed bottom-nav's y-range (820..900, h-20 = 80px). Bottom-nav therefore intercepts pointer events at that spot. Reproduction: /pair/BTCUSDT on 420x900 viewport → 3-dot menu → Edit Position → fill values → tap Save → observe: no POST fires, modal closes (from backdrop click), no toast. Mitigation: apply pb-24 to modal panel OR wrap modal render in a portal with z-index higher than bottom-nav OR conditionally hide bottom-nav when posEditOpen.
